newsitem.title: UK: London shares open higher, lifted by Dow advance.
newsitem.headline: London shares open higher, lifted by Dow advance.

text.p: UK shares started firmer on Monday as investors took heart from Wall Street's surge last Friday, but fear of higher interest rates continued to weigh on market sentiment, dealers said.
"We've had a predictable mark up this morning but it's anyones guess if it will last," the head of sales and trading at a large investment bank said.
"A lot of people are still worried about the threat of higher interest rates."
The FTSE 100 index of leading shares was 17.4 points higher at 4,06.9 by 0834 GMT.
